title: Kelnacca
description: A Wookiee Jedi Master of the High Republic era, Kelnacca accompanied Master Indara on the planet Brendok to investigate a vergence in the Force. After the shocking turn of events on Brendok and his violent possession by the witches of Brendok, Kelnacca sequestered himself to the planet Khofar for a life of isolation and penance.
